title: settings v2 polish and library toolbar

commit.merge_subject: merge: settings v2 polish and library toolbar

description:
Settings v2 polish step 7 (VERIFY): the spec's Compose UI tests,
where the project's setup allows them.

The project already wires Compose UI test setup (ui-test-junit4
in androidTestImplementation, ui-test-manifest debug-only,
AndroidJUnitRunner configured, an androidTest source set), so
step 7's pager/slider tests are added as instrumented tests —
Robolectric is not declared and adding it would be a forbidden
dependency change, so they cannot run on the host; they compile
offline and run under connectedDebugAndroidTest on a device.

DeviceReportScreenTest pins the C5 pager contract: one swipe
left advances exactly one page (0 -> 1, not 0 -> 2); a second
swipe reaches page 2; clicking the Encoders tab selects page 2
and shows only encoders; the Decoders tab shows only decoders;
the tab row exposes all three tabs with selectable semantics.

ThemeSliderTest pins the C4 gesture contract on
changed: ui: pinned library toolbar replaces chip strip
ui: library sort and view state persist
ui: library names wrap at separators
ui: segmented control uses stock m3 row
ui: theme slider system slot a glyph
ui: device report tabs and pager
ui: device report and theme slider instrumented tests
